projects.name: ISO20022Migration MT TO MX
details: July 2019 – Aug 2021
• Worked on SEPA (Direct Debits, Credit Transfers, Mandate Management),
domestic and cross-border clearing (ACH/Clearing House, NEFT, RTGS), and ISO
20022 XML messages (pain001, pain002, pain008, pacs002/004/008).
• Product vision, roadmap, MVP scope, and delivery priorities.
• Manage and maintain the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business
objectives.
• Participated in requirement gathering and Analysis, BRDs, FRDs, and solution
scope documents, translating business needs into actionable requirements.
• Acted as SME, providing integrated business/technical solutions, supporting
Agile delivery, and assisting with testing, validation, and post-deployment
support.
• Facilitated workshops, stakeholder discussions, and solution reviewsto align
implementation with global payment standards.
• Product Development, Solution Analysis, Stakeholder Management for
incorporating various digital platforms ensuring sustainable digitization for
various.
• Strong analytical skills with ability to map business requirements into required
functional components.
• Coordinate and oversee SIT, UAT, and production validation testing activities.
• Prepare Gap Analysis / understand the functional gaps based on business
requirements.
• Understand Global Payments Business and Trends.
• Domestic clearing like NEFT, ECS, ACH, CHAPS / FEDWIRE / CHIPS / Target2,
RTGS
• RTP schemes like NPP / FAST / IMPS / InstaPay etc.
• Interviewingbusinessunits,stakeholders,andtechnicalleaderstogather and clarify
business requirements; developing to be business process flows, identifying the
impact of the implementation on these business process flows and coordinating
the review of the detail design for the business.
• ActasaSME,providingintegratedbusiness/technicalsolutionstodevelop products
in order to cater the business, operational & market needs.
• Verification/Validationofrequirementstoensuretheydeliverbusiness.
• Worked under of all phases of SDLC methodologies like Waterfall and Agile.
• SuccessfullyparticipatedinvariousScrumCeremoniesbysharingopinions on
process & product innovation.
• Gained insights during designing ideas in relation to technical up
gradation,cocoordinatingwithdevelopmentteamduringdevelopment& post
development maintenance as point of contact for business domain.
• ConductingInductionandTrainingProgramforthenewteamandbusiness users on
product and upgraded automated process.
• Experience in mapping business requirements & designing customized solutions
with strong analytical skills & capabilities to analyze business practices and
define optimal procedures.
